'''Catapults''' were tracked [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] vehicles used by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. '''Heavy Catapults''' were their upgraded versions. Two Catapults under the command of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]] joined with a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] strike force to [[Battle of Geddes|recover]] a [[Jedi artifact/Legends|Jedi artifact]], the [[Vor'Na'Tu]], soon after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. The vehicles also saw action during the [[Liberation of Kashyyyk/Legends|Liberation of Kashyyyk]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. They were constructed at [[Heavy Weapons Factory|factories]] at a cost of fifty units of [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]] and ninety units of [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]]. The [[Catapult/Legends|Catapults]] were armed with one energy [[Cannon/Legends|cannon]] and the Heavy Catapults with two.

==Behind the scenes==
Catapults and Heavy Catapults appear in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''. The campaign was later included in its [[2002]] [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|expansion pack]]. An image of a Catapult was used to represent the "artillery" unit in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]''
